findings.claim: 10-K 列出 PSG 主要對手為 Infineon、STMicroelectronics、Wolfspeed、ROHM、Nexperia；AMG 對手含 TI、ADI、Infineon、ST、Renesas、MPS、NXP。
findings.excerpt: PSG’s primary competitors include: Infineon Technologies AG ("Infineon"), STMicroelectronics N.V. ("STMicroelectronics"), Wolfspeed Inc., ROHM Semiconductor and Nexperia BV.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司承認 AI 資料中心電源可能無法如預期取得份額，失敗將導致市占流失；且無法保證贏得 design win。
findings.excerpt: Our failure to commercialize new technologies that can power AI data centers in a timely manner or at all could result in a loss of market share, unanticipated costs and inventory obsolescence, which could adversely affect our financial results.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分對手獲政府補貼，若公司拿不到相同補助可能影響市占。
findings.excerpt: In addition, some of our competitors may receive governmental subsidies or other incentives that give them a competitive advantage over us.
